summary: Publish the CLI actor syntax as a generated, versioned contract and report effective instance and state directory on request.

rules.detail: No authority rule or command behavior change.

compatibility.detail: Adds st actor-contract --json and optional --effective output. Static mode reads no config and contacts no daemon. Effective output exposes only selected instance, default config_path and resolved state_dir metadata, not config values; config_path is always Config::default_path(), not evidence of an actual custom config file loaded. Existing CLI commands, config resolution, wire APIs and actor defaults are unchanged. The new syntax contract does not grant person authority. kind st3.actor-contract.v1 and version 1 stay for: new commands, new aliases, new optional fields on an entry, and new values of an existing enum (actor, and any later enum). Readers MUST ignore unknown fields and MUST treat an unknown enum value as unknown, never as one of the values they know; they must not infer --as syntax, person support or authority from an unknown value. kind and version bump together for: a removed or renamed field, a changed field type, a removed enum value, or a changed meaning of an existing field or value. contract_sha256 changes with ANY content change (a command moving class included) and identifies one binary build; it is not a version. The contract describes argv syntax and is never an authorization input. No actor-contract reader exists in this repository yet; the unknown-enum rule is a requirement on future readers. Existing tests parse JSON only to check the producer's output and snapshot, not to interpret unknown actor values.

manual.detail: Operators may read the new contract instead of maintaining a command list. Operator policy and authority checks remain in place.
